requestBody.description: Create a generation job. Send application/json for URL or assetId inputs. For local files, request an upload URL with POST /v2/assets/upload, PUT the file to uploadUrl, register the returned url with POST /v2/assets, then send the asset id in input[].assetId here. A video input url that links to a single TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or YouTube video is imported first: the generation is created PENDING and starts once the video is downloaded, or ends FAILED with errorCode import_failed if the import fails. A linked audio input, or a linked video in a segments, dubbing or mimic request, answers 409 import_in_progress until its import finishes; send the same request (with the same Idempotency-Key, if any) again after Retry-After. Uploads must fit your plan and the 5 GiB single-upload limit. Direct multipart/form-data audio, video, or image fields remain supported up to 5 GiB per file, subject to your plan; files are streamed through temporary storage and registered as assets; the multipart/form-data schema lists the file fields and the nested fields sent as JSON strings.

Poll it instead of resubmitting, or send a unique Idempotency-Key with each intended generation. Controller duplicate conflicts use generation_conflict. import_in_progress while a linked audio input (or a linked video in a segments, dubbing or mimic request) is still importing; send the same request again after Retry-After.

severity.description: blocker: you could not finish. major: you finished with a workaround. minor: an annoyance.

tool.description: MCP tool or API operation the feedback is about.

errorCode.description: Error code you received, such as an errorCode field.

jobId.description: Other job the feedback is about: an import, transcription or translation id.

source.description: Where the report comes from. The sync. MCP server sends mcp.

mcpVersion.description: sync. MCP server version, sent by the MCP server.

name.description: Your client or agent, such as an MCP host name.

reviewedDub.description: Generate from saved reviewed dubbing corrections and current audio takes.

dialogueEdit.description: Use the id of a completed dialogue edit from POST /v2/dialogue-edits to supply the audio and edited regions. Requires a preview that ran segment lipsync and section expansion (see the job's segmentLipsyncEnabled and sectionExpansionEnabled). Send exactly one video input, the same video the dialogue edit was made from, and no audio input, segments or dubParams. The output follows the edited audio: footage the edit shortened is retimed into its neighbours. A removal too large for them to absorb returns 422 dialogue_edit_removal_too_large with the section to change in dialogueEditSection; restore some words there and create a new dialogue edit. Billing, status, wait and webhooks work as for any generation.

model.description: name of the model to use for generation.

input.description: Array of input objects. Standard lipsync requests without segments require exactly one visual input (video or image) and one audio or text input. Multi-segment lipsync requests require exactly one video plus one or more audio/text inputs; give each audio/text input a unique refId and reference it from segments[].audioInput.refId. Multi-speaker requests use speakers[].audio.refId to reference audio/text inputs on a shared video timeline. Dubbed lipsync requests using dubParams require exactly one video and no audio/text input because the dubbed audio is extracted from that video.

segments.description: one or more segments definition to apply edits to

outputAudio.description: One audio input that plays over the whole finished output from its first second, replacing the sound of every part, lipsynced or not. Use it with segments, for example one dubbed track for a whole video where some segments set lipsync: false. When any segment sets lipsync: false and this is omitted, the only audio input is used. Not available with a custom output bucket, zero data retention or a retention override.

speakers.description: Speakers to lipsync on a shared video timeline (sync-3 only). Requires multispeaker_enabled. The default limit is 3, configurable per organization. Each audio must match the video duration. Cannot be combined with segments, sync_mode, dubbing or global speaker selection.

projectId.description: Attach this generation to a project (from POST /v2/projects) so it appears in Studio under that project.

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL for generation status updates. When the generation reaches a terminal state, Sync sends a POST request with the generation payload, a Sync-Signature header (`t=<unix>,v1=<hmac_sha256>`), and a stable Sync-Delivery-Id header. Verify the signature with the organization webhook secret from GET /v2/organizations/webhook/secret. Delivery is attempted up to six times with a bounded per-attempt timeout (10 seconds by default); retryable responses may provide Retry-After. HTTPS is strongly recommended.

outputFileName.description: filename for the generated output (up to 255 characters). Characters outside letters, numbers, dashes and underscores are stripped and spaces become underscores, so "My Clip!.mp4" is stored as "My_Clipmp4".

dubParams.description: Dubbing parameters. When present, audio is extracted from the single video input, dubbed via ElevenLabs into the target language, and then lipsync is run with the dubbed audio. Do not include audio or text inputs with dubParams; requests that send both are rejected.

model.description: name of the model to use for generation.

Verify the signature with the organization webhook secret from GET /v2/organizations/webhook/secret. Delivery is attempted up to six times with a bounded per-attempt timeout (10 seconds by default); retryable responses may provide Retry-After. HTTPS is strongly recommended.

audio.description: Audio file, up to 5 GiB and within your plan limit. Replaces any audio item in input.

video.description: Video file, up to 5 GiB and within your plan limit. Replaces any video item in input.

image.description: Image file, up to 5 GiB and within your plan limit. Replaces any image item in input.

input.description: JSON string of the input array for url, assetId or text inputs. Required unless an audio, video or image file is sent; an uploaded file replaces any input item of the same type.

options.description: JSON string of the generation options object.

segments.description: JSON string of the segments array.

outputAudio.description: JSON string of the outputAudio object: the audio input that plays over the whole output.

speakers.description: JSON string of the speakers array.

dubParams.description: JSON string of the dubParams object.

dialogueEdit.description: JSON string of the dialogueEdit reference. Send the source video by url or assetId in input; a dialogue edit request with an uploaded file is rejected with 422.

generationEstimate.description: Completion estimate for eligible interactive generations, with a fixed deadline and current server time. Absent when no estimate is available.

inputSnapshot.description: Frozen reviewed inputs for reopening this generation. Null for legacy generations; returned by GET /v2/generate/{id}.

id.description: A unique identifier for the generation.

createdAt.description: The date and time the generation was created.

model.description: The name of the model used for generation.

projectId.description: The id of the project this generation is attached to, or null when it belongs to no project. Set via the `projectId` field on the create request.

input.description: An array of input objects containing type and URL.

segments.description: The segments definition for the generation.

speakers.description: The speakers selected for this generation.

webhookUrl.description: The URL to the webhook endpoint.

outputUrl.description: The URL of the output media.

outputDuration.description: The duration of the output media.

segmentOutputUrl.description: The URL of the segment output media.

outputFileName.description: The sanitized filename applied to the output media. Non-alphanumeric characters (except dashes and underscores) are stripped and spaces become underscores, so the value here is the canonical name used for the downloaded file - it may differ from what was submitted. Null when no name was provided.

synthesizedAudioUrl.description: The URL of the audio synthesized from a text input. Only present for generations created with a TTS text input; reuse it as an audio input to keep the same take across generations.

error.description: The error message if the generation failed.

errorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code if the generation failed. The full catalog with messages and suggested fixes is served at GET /v2/errors.

progress_percent.description: The progress percentage of the generation (0-100). Only included when include=progress.

errorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code from GET /v2/errors, for example insufficient_credits, account_payment_required, unpaid_usage_limit_reached, free_tier_generations_exhausted, plan_feature_unavailable, generation_plan_duration_exceeded or voice_clone_limit_reached.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, safe to show a person.

billingUrl.description: Studio billing page where a person can upgrade, pay an invoice, update the payment method or, on prepaid credit plans, top up. It needs a signed-in browser. Only insufficient_credits rejections can be fixed by topping up; usage-based plans are invoiced and have no credits.

requiredPlan.description: plan_feature_unavailable: plan id that unlocks the feature or endpoint. enterprise means no self-serve plan does; contact sync.

requiredCredits.description: insufficient_credits: credits the refused work needed (1 credit = $0.01).

availableCredits.description: insufficient_credits: credits that could be spent when the work was refused, after reservations by in-flight jobs.

limit.description: Count limit that was reached: free generations, free speech or dubbing jobs, free previews, or cloned voices.

used.description: How much of limit is already used.

limitSeconds.description: Duration limit that was exceeded, in seconds.

requestedSeconds.description: Duration the refused work needed, in seconds (rounded up).

unpaidUsageCents.description: unpaid_usage_limit_reached: metered usage not yet paid, in US cents.

unpaidUsageLimitCents.description: unpaid_usage_limit_reached: the unpaid usage limit that was reached, in US cents.

fps.description: Source video frame rate. When omitted, credit-billed organizations are quoted at 25, the rate generation admission holds credits at when the source frame rate cannot be read; other organizations at 30.

workflow.description: Omit for lip-sync only. translate-and-dub includes dubbing and lip-sync, estimated using the source duration. Actual output duration may differ.

durationCheck.description: Current account and selected-model output-duration eligibility for the quoted duration. A price is not permission to generate; admission rechecks all limits.

breakdown.description: Present for translate-and-dub. Top-level amounts are the combined Sync estimate. External provider charges are unpriced (null) and excluded; included dubbing has no additional Sync charge. Estimates do not reserve credits or guarantee admission.

message.description: Why a billable duration could not be estimated.

suggestion.description: How to resolve the media or duration problem.

features.description: Marketing feature tags for the model

playbackMediaUrl.description: Browser playback URL, using a preview when available. Use outputMediaUrl or the download endpoint for the original output.

preview.description: Offer a bounded source quote when the source exceeds the applicable duration limit. Does not mark a job as an audition.

isPreview.description: Quote a short audition using the separate free preview allowance. Use the same mode when creating the job.

numSpeakers.description: Deprecated and ignored. Dubbing v2 detects speakers automatically.

cloningStrength.description: Voice cloning strength for Dubbing v2, from 1 to 10. Omit to use provider defaults. Studio starts at 7.

playbackMediaUrl.description: Browser playback URL, using a preview when available. Use outputMediaUrl or the download endpoint for the original output.

latestAssetThumbnailUrl.description: Preview for the latest uploaded visual asset: the thumbnail for videos, the image itself for images.

latestAssetAttachedAt.description: When the latest visual draft asset was first attached to the project, so clients can rank it against the latest generation by recency.

id.description: Optional client-supplied project id (UUID) for idempotent creation. Re-sending the same id returns the existing project instead of creating a duplicate; the other request fields are ignored on such a replay. If the id is already used by a different user or organization, or by a deleted project, the request fails with 409.

visibility.description: Who can see the project. Defaults to USER (visible only to the owner).

defaultWorkflow.description: Default top-level creator workflow for this project.

playbackMediaUrl.description: Browser playback URL, using a preview when available. Use outputMediaUrl or the download endpoint for the original output.

webhook_url.description: Webhook server URL to notify when the batch reaches a terminal status. Sync sends a POST request with a batch payload, a Sync-Signature header (`t=<unix>,v1=<hmac_sha256>`), and a stable Sync-Delivery-Id header. Delivery is attempted up to six times with a bounded per-attempt timeout (10 seconds by default); retryable responses may provide Retry-After. The signature uses the organization webhook secret.

dry_run.description: When true, validates the batch input and returns `{ "status": "VALIDATED" }` without creating a batch.

rows.description: Batch rows in submission order, one per generation. Each row has the same shape as one line of the multipart JSONL file and is validated the same way; error messages cite `line N` for `rows[N-1]`. Requires at least 20 rows, at most 500 rows by default, unique `request_id` values, and at most 5 MB when serialized as JSONL (one compact JSON object per line).

input.description: JSONL file for batch generation. Send it in multipart field `input` (or `file` alias). Each non-empty line must contain `request_id`, `endpoint` exactly `"/v2/generate"`, and `payload` as a CreateGenerationDto object. Batch creation requires the Scale plan, at least 20 records, at most 500 records by default, no duplicate request_id values, and a file size no larger than 5 MB.

webhook_url.description: Webhook server URL to notify when the batch reaches a terminal status. Sync sends a POST request with a batch payload, a Sync-Signature header (`t=<unix>,v1=<hmac_sha256>`), and a stable Sync-Delivery-Id header. Delivery is attempted up to six times with a bounded per-attempt timeout (10 seconds by default); retryable responses may provide Retry-After. The signature uses the organization webhook secret.

dry_run.description: When true, validates the batch input and returns `{ "status": "VALIDATED" }` without creating a batch.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the active batch limit.
message.example: Batch concurrency limit reached. You have 3 active batches and your plan allows 3. Please wait for existing batches to complete or upgrade your plan for higher limits.

activeBatches.description: Number of active batches in the organization.

concurrencyLimit.description: Maximum number of concurrent batches allowed by the plan.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Suggested seconds to wait before retrying. Also sent in the Retry-After response header.

account.description: The user this credential acts for: the signed-in user for sessions and OAuth tokens, or the API key owner. Null for an API key that has no owner.

role.description: Role the credential acts with: owner, admin or member. API keys always act as member.

organization.description: The organization every request with this credential acts in.

credentialType.description: api_key: an x-api-key header. oauth: an access token issued to a connected app such as an MCP client. session: a Studio sign-in (cookie or plugin bearer token).

id.description: Stable plan identifier. free means no paid plan.

name.description: Plan name to show a person.

billingModel.description: How generations are paid for, which decides how to recover from a 402. credits: prepaid credits; top up, turn on auto top-up or upgrade at billingUrl. usage: usage is metered and invoiced; pay the open invoice or update the payment method at billingUrl. Usage-based organizations cannot top up. free: a monthly free allowance; upgrade to a paid plan at billingUrl. enterprise: negotiated billing (enterprise, partner and program plans, including pilots); contact your sync. account team.

concurrency.description: Lipsync generations that can run at once. Further submissions get 429 concurrency_limit_reached until one finishes.

maxOutputDurationSeconds.description: Longest output a generation may produce on this plan, in seconds. Some models have a lower limit (GET /v2/models).

maxFileSizeBytes.description: Largest input file the plan accepts, in bytes.

voiceClones.description: Cloned voices the organization can keep at once.

limits.description: Current plan limits, including organization overrides.

generations.description: In-flight video lipsync generations. Compare with limits.concurrency; batch generations are included here but do not count toward it.

total.description: All in-flight jobs, including dubbing and text-to-speech. Not a limit.

activeJobs.description: Jobs pending or processing right now. May be up to a few seconds stale.

available.description: Credits that can be spent now: the balance minus credits reserved by in-flight jobs. 1 credit = $0.01.

periodGrant.description: Credits the plan grants each billing period.

autoTopUp.description: Whether credits are bought automatically when the balance runs low.

credits.description: Prepaid credit balance when billingModel is credits; null otherwise.

billingPeriod.description: Current billing period. Without a subscription this is the calendar month.

used.description: Uses counted in the current free month.

remaining.description: Uses left this free month (limit minus used, never below 0).

generations.description: Free lipsync generations. In-flight generations count as used.

used.description: Uses counted in the current free month.

remaining.description: Uses left this free month (limit minus used, never below 0).

speech.description: Free text-to-speech and dubbing jobs, which share one pool.

resetsAt.description: When the free month resets. It is anchored to the day the organization was created.

freeAllowance.description: Free monthly allowance when billingModel is free; null otherwise.

billingUrl.description: Studio billing page where a person can change plan, pay, top up or update the payment method. Send a person here; it needs a signed-in browser.

transcript.description: The transcript the edits refer to, as returned by GET /v2/transcriptions/{id}. Edits name words by their `id` in this transcript. Word timings are in milliseconds from the start of the source video.

pronunciation.description: Optional. How the voice should say `replacement`, written as a plain-text respelling, for a name or word it would otherwise mispronounce. The voice speaks this text instead of `replacement`; the transcripts and edits on the job keep `replacement`, and punctuation at the end of `replacement` still shapes the intonation. Example: `{ "kind": "change", "wordId": "w35", "replacement": "Mia", "pronunciation": "Meeah" }`. 1 to 100 characters of letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, and periods, with at least one letter. Accepted on `change` edits only.
Not accepted on `remove` edits: a removal says nothing. Sending it returns 400.

edits.description: The edits to apply: `change` replaces one word (`wordId`, `replacement`, and an optional `pronunciation` respelling for the voice), `remove` cuts a contiguous run of words (`wordIds`). Between 1 and 100 edits per job; more is refused with a 400 and `errorCode` `dialogue_edit_too_many_edits`.

sourceVideoUrl.description: URL of the source video the transcript was made from, hosted in sync. storage (upload it via POST /v2/assets/upload first).

transcriptionJobId.description: The transcription job this edit is based on. Send it so the edit and the transcript agree on the source.

startMs.description: Start of the edited window, in milliseconds from the start of the source. Use the same window the transcript was made for. Defaults to 0. API-key requests must leave startMs and endMs unset to cover the whole video.

endMs.description: End of the edited window, in milliseconds from the start of the source. Omit to run to the end. The window cannot exceed 10 minutes. API-key requests must leave startMs and endMs unset to cover the whole video.

voiceId.description: Opaque voice id returned as `voiceId` by an earlier dialogue-edit job of the same source. Reusing it skips cloning the voice again. Omit on the first job for a source. Ids your organization has not used before are ignored.

projectId.description: Optional id of a project in your organization to file the job under.

rerunOfJobId.description: Id of the completed dialogue-edit job this request revises, when regenerating a preview after adjusting the edits. Informational lineage only; unknown ids are ignored.

id.description: Job id. Poll GET /v2/dialogue-edits/{id} with it.

status.description: Job status. `COMPLETED`, `COMPLETED_PARTIAL` and `FAILED` are terminal. `COMPLETED_PARTIAL` means the preview is playable but shipped without something that was requested; treat it as completed.

sourceVideoUrl.description: The source video the job was created from.

sourceStartMs.description: Start of the edited window, in source milliseconds.

sourceEndMs.description: End of the edited window, in source milliseconds. Null when the job runs to the end of the source.

previewAudioUrl.description: Hosted WAV of the edited audio for the whole window: the original recording with only the edited spans re-synthesized. Null until the job completes.

previewAssetId.description: Always null. To lipsync a preview, pass its id as `dialogueEdit: { id }` on POST /v2/generate.

previewDurationMs.description: Length of the preview audio in milliseconds. Differs from the window length by however much the edits grew or shrank it. Null until the job completes.

sourceTranscript.description: The transcript the edits were made against, exactly as submitted. Returned in every status.

pronunciation.description: Optional. How the voice should say `replacement`, written as a plain-text respelling, for a name or word it would otherwise mispronounce. The voice speaks this text instead of `replacement`; the transcripts and edits on the job keep `replacement`, and punctuation at the end of `replacement` still shapes the intonation. Example: `{ "kind": "change", "wordId": "w35", "replacement": "Mia", "pronunciation": "Meeah" }`. 1 to 100 characters of letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, and periods, with at least one letter. Accepted on `change` edits only.

edits.description: The edits that were applied, exactly as submitted.

resultTranscript.description: The transcript as it reads after the edits, with every word timed against the preview audio. Null until the job completes.

resultSlots.description: The edited regions in order, each located on the preview timeline (`outputStartMs`, `outputDurationMs`) and in the source video (`sourceStartMs`, `sourceDurationMs`). Everything between two slots is untouched source. Null until the job completes.

segmentLipsyncEnabled.description: Whether the preview was cut for per-region lipsync (true) or for re-lipsyncing the whole window (false). Decided when the job is created and fixed for its lifetime. For jobs created with an API key, the rollout is evaluated against the organization's members.

sectionExpansionEnabled.description: Whether the preview was made under the section-expansion policy. Decided when the job is created and fixed for its lifetime. For jobs created with an API key, the rollout is evaluated against the organization's members.

voiceId.description: Opaque id of the voice cloned from the source and used for synthesis. Pass it as `voiceId` on the next dialogue-edit job of the same source to skip cloning. Null until the voice exists.

partialDetail.description: What a completed preview shipped without: edited regions that may sound rough, or a background that could not be kept. The preview is playable either way. Null or absent when nothing was missed, and until the job completes.

slotsTotal.description: How many edited regions the preview has.

slotsOk.description: How many of them passed the quality checks.

errorCode.description: Why the region may sound rough: `QC_SEAM_STEP` (an audible level jump where the region meets the original audio), `QC_DIGITAL_BLACK` (a stretch of dead silence inside the region), `TAKE_OUTLIERS` (no synthesized take matched the speaker closely), or `QC_NO_ROOM_TONE` (dead silence in the region because the source has no clean background stretch to fill its pauses with; not retried). New codes may be added.

failedSlots.description: Edited regions that shipped with a detected defect, after one automatic retry where a retry could help. The preview still plays; regenerating it or rewording the edit may help.

reason.description: `background_bed_missing`: the background was requested but the preview shipped with the speech alone.

code.description: Machine-readable failure code. `EDIT_TOO_LONG`, `SOURCE_TOO_LONG`, `VOICE_SAMPLE_TOO_SHORT`, `VOICE_BLOCKED`, `VOICE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED` and `PLAN_FAILED` describe the request and will not succeed on retry.

spanText.description: For `EDIT_TOO_LONG`: the replacement text that does not fit the time its span has to occupy. Shorten it and resubmit.

wordIds.description: For `EDIT_TOO_LONG`: ids of the words in the submitted transcript that the span replaces, in transcript order. Unedited words regenerated together with the edit are included.

speakerId.description: For `VOICE_BLOCKED`: the transcript speaker whose voice the speech provider refuses to clone.

error.description: Why the job failed. Null unless `status` is `FAILED`.

sourceVideoUrl.description: URL of the source video, hosted in sync. storage (upload it via POST /v2/assets/upload first). Provide exactly one of `sourceVideoUrl` or `sourceAudioUrl`.

sourceAudioUrl.description: URL of audio already extracted from the source, hosted in sync. storage. Skips the server-side audio extraction. Provide exactly one of `sourceVideoUrl` or `sourceAudioUrl`.

startMs.description: Start of the window to transcribe, in milliseconds from the start of the source. Defaults to 0.

endMs.description: End of the window to transcribe, in milliseconds from the start of the source. Omit to transcribe to the end. The window cannot exceed 60 minutes.

maxSourceSeconds.description: Refuse the source if it is longer than this many seconds. Useful when a later step, such as a dialogue edit (10 minute window), cannot consume a longer transcript. Cannot exceed the endpoint ceiling of 3600 seconds.

projectId.description: Optional id of a project in your organization to file the job under.

id.description: Job id. Poll GET /v2/transcriptions/{id} with it.

revision.description: Content hash of the source and transcript this job produced. Present once the job has a transcript.

sourceVideoUrl.description: The source video the job was created from. Null for jobs created from `sourceAudioUrl`.

sourceStartMs.description: Start of the transcribed window, in source milliseconds.

sourceEndMs.description: End of the transcribed window, in source milliseconds. Null when the job transcribes to the end of the source.

transcript.description: Word-level transcript. Word timings are in milliseconds from the start of the source video, not the window. Null until `status` is `COMPLETED`.

speakerCount.description: Number of distinct speakers detected. Dialogue edits currently support a single speaker; a count above 1 completes the job but a dialogue edit of that source is unsupported. Null until `status` is `COMPLETED`.

difficulty.description: Informational estimate of how hard the source is to edit cleanly, with the reasons behind it. Null while the job is running and for some older jobs. Do not gate behaviour on it.

code.description: Machine-readable failure code. `NO_AUDIO`, `NO_AUDIO_TRACK` and `SOURCE_TOO_LONG` describe the source and will not succeed on retry.

error.description: Why the job failed. Null unless `status` is `FAILED`.

id.description: Id of a completed dialogue edit from POST /v2/dialogue-edits.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL to a source video. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

assetId.description: Sync asset ID for a previously uploaded video. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

items.description: First number is start time, second number is end time

segments_secs.description: Start and end time in seconds for each video segment to apply generation to

items.description: First number is start frame, second number is end frame

segments_frames.description: Start and end frames for each video segment to apply generation to

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL to a source video. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

assetId.description: Sync asset ID for a previously uploaded video. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL to a source image. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

assetId.description: Sync asset ID for a previously uploaded image. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL to a source image. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

assetId.description: Sync asset ID for a previously uploaded image. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

refId.description: Reference id used by `segments[].audioInput.refId` or `speakers[].audio.refId` when a generation has more than one audio or text input.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL to a source audio file. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

assetId.description: Sync asset ID for a previously uploaded audio file. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) URL to a source audio file. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

assetId.description: Sync asset ID for a previously uploaded audio file. Either `url` or `assetId` is required.

refId.description: Reference id used by `segments[].audioInput.refId` or `speakers[].audio.refId` when a generation has more than one audio or text input.

prompt.description: Prompt for the generation. For appearence-1, this is the appearance edit instruction sent with the video and reference images.
prompt.example: add a red hat to the speaker

prompt_image_uris.description: Reference image URLs for appearance editing generations. API consumers can pass direct reference images here, or pass the imageUrl returned by POST /v2/appearence/preview.

i2v_prompt.description: Prompt for image-to-video generation. Defaults to none.
i2v_prompt.example: make the subject smile and look at the camera

model_mode.description: mode of the model to use for animation.

temperature.description: generation temperature randomness between 0 and 1. note: only works for lipsync-2 based models.

sync_mode.description: lipsync mode when audio and video durations are out of sync.

reasoning_enabled.description: Whether to analyze and correct frames with artifacts, occlusions, or extreme poses during generation, slows down generation speed.

refinement_enabled.description: Whether to enable the refinement pass for the generation.

blending_mode.description: Controls how blending is applied during generation.

face_boxes_url.description: URL for precomputed face bounding boxes.

occlusion_detection_enabled.description: Whether to detect occlusion during generation, slows down generation speed.

active_speaker.description: Whether to detect active speaker and apply generation to them.

speedup.description: downscale inputs for faster generations. used to preview changes.

output_format.description: format of the output media that is generated.

fps.description: Frames per second (FPS) for the output video

output_resolution.description: Resolution of the output video [width, height]

audioInput.description: Audio Input for this segment. Required unless lipsync is false.

lipsync.description: false keeps this part of the video exactly as it is: it is not lipsynced and is not billed. The finished output then plays one audio track over the whole video (see outputAudio), so these parts hear it too, with no cuts at segment edges.

refId.description: refId of the audio input to play over the whole output.

id.description: Unique speaker id containing letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. The id default is reserved.

audio.description: Audio/text input reference, optionally cropped to match the video duration.

face.description: Select this speaker explicitly. Automatic speaker detection is not supported.

providerName.description: Provider to use for dubbing. Defaults to ElevenLabs.

targetLang.description: Target language code for dubbing (e.g., "es" for Spanish, "fr" for French).

sourceLang.description: Source language code. Defaults to "auto" for automatic detection.

numSpeakers.description: Deprecated and ignored by Dubbing v2; speaker count is detected automatically.

cloningStrength.description: Voice cloning strength for Dubbing v2, from 1 to 10. Higher values preserve more of the source voice. Omit to use provider defaults. Studio starts at 7.

request_id.description: Identifier for this row. Must be unique within the batch.

endpoint.description: Endpoint the row is submitted to. Only `/v2/generate` is supported.

voiceId.description: Sync voice ID (copied from cloned voices in the Studio) or ElevenLabs voice ID. Required.

stability.description: Voice stability (0-1). Lower = more expressive, higher = more stable.

similarityBoost.description: Voice similarity boost (0-1). Lower = more creative, higher = stricter adherence.

auto_detect.description: Whether to detect active speaker automatically and apply generation to them.

use_v2.description: Deprecated. ASD v2 is now the default; use v3 to opt into ASD v3.

frame_number.description: Frame number selected for speaker selection

coordinates.description: Pixel coordinates [x, y] in the source video frame identified by frame_number. Coordinates are forwarded as-is to active speaker selection; they are not normalized ratios.

face_image.description: Base64 encoded face image for selected speaker (128x128 WebP)

refId.description: Reference to an audio input by refId
